newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium urges urgent action on UN force in Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Belgium urges urgent action on UN force in Zaire.

text.p: Belgian Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene urged the United Nations on Tuesday to act urgently to send a multinational force to eastern Zaire and said Belgium would provide logistical and financial assistance.
"This operation should guarantee the security of the distribution of humanitarian aid to refugees as well as their voluntary return to their country of origin," Dehaene said in a statement.

U.N. Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali said earlier on Tuesday that Canada was ready to lead a multinational force to ease the way for relief supplies to more than a million refugees displaced by fighting between the Zairean army and Tutsi-led rebels.

Belgium has not offered to send troops to its former colony. But Dehaene said it was willing to provide logistical and financial support for the participation of African troops, including air transport.

Dehaene also announced that Belgium had granted emergency aid of 300 million francs ($9.6 million) to international groups working in Zaire and planned to organise special humanitarian flights from Europe to Zaire.
